title: Swarm robotics: VLMs and SLAM
summary: Integrating vision-language models into SLAM algorithms and robot-to-robot communication.
description: In Kevin Moon’s lab at Utah State University, I’m working on how robots share and interpret observations without a central controller. I’m adapting algorithms that merge object annotations across their maps so observations of the same object can be linked without creating duplicate entries.

title: VNForge
summary: A desktop workspace that turns story scenes into validated, playable visual-novel projects.
description: Built with a team for the IBM AI Builders Challenge in July 2026. I led the team and developed core files, implemented features, fixed reported defects, and integrated interface improvements. A local compiler generates Ren’Py from a validated scene plan.

title: Rock iguana microbiomes
summary: Studying how seasonality and human activity relate to the microbiome and physiology of endangered Bahamian rock iguanas.
description: Analyzed gut microbiome and health data using mixed-effects models and multivariate tests. Developed a regression model to combine glucose readings from two instruments, and automated analysis workflows with Nextflow for an HPC cluster. The work led to two pending publications.

title: PAM250 matrix match
summary: A small Python tool that scores aligned amino-acid pairs using the PAM250 substitution matrix.
description: Created to replace a repetitive research task for me and my colleagues: looking up substitution scores for aligned amino acids. A focused script for a practical problem.

title: Lucid competition
summary: Built a rule-based bot for Lucid’s real-time strategy competition and advanced to the semifinals.
description: Built a rule-based bot for Lucid’s November 2026 real-time strategy competition. Our team advanced to the semifinals.
